totalReturnEvidence.methodDescription: NAV multiplied by cumulative pre-ex-date NAV/(pre-ex-date NAV minus gross distribution). Independently reconciled against Fundmarket annual returns and same-response indicative YTD; not a directly supplied Fundmarket total-return series.
totalReturnEvidence.toleranceReason: Absolute ceiling of two basis points for propagation of NAVs published to two decimal places; no relative tolerance or fitted factors.
